parameters.query:
-- Abandoned quote/partner enquiries: the customer engaged, gave us at
-- least a phone number and usually more, then stopped replying without
-- completing the flow. These never reach the Quote/Partner tabs (those are
-- written only on successful submission), so sales has never seen them.
--
-- Deliberately EVENT-FREE: a sweeper catches plain abandonment (customer
-- just stops replying), which is the most common outcome and which no
-- exit/handoff hook can ever catch -- there is no event to hang off.
--
-- 30 min idle matches the Decision Node's own conversation-timeout, so a
-- lead is only swept once the session is genuinely dead, never mid-chat.
-- The 7-day floor stops a backfill avalanche on first run and keeps the
-- follow-up list fresh; widen it ONCE deliberately if you want history.
SELECT
  phone,
  current_state,
  current_context,
  created_at,
  updated_at,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - updated_at)) / 60) AS minutes_idle
FROM app_bot_sessions
WHERE current_state IN ('QUOTE_COLLECTING', 'QUOTE_CONFIRMING', 'PARTNER_COLLECTING', 'PARTNER_CONFIRMING')
  AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
  AND updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND COALESCE(current_context->>'leadExported', '') <> 'true'
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

nodes.name: Write Lead to Sheets
nodes.notes: SETUP: assign the same Google Sheets credential the main workflow uses (credentials never travel through workflow JSON exports), and create a 'Leads' tab whose header row matches the column keys mapped here. appendOrUpdate on phone = one living row per prospect, refreshed with their latest details rather than a new row per sweep. | FIXED 2026-08-13: was onError continueRegularOutput, which meant a FAILED sheet write still flowed on to Mark Lead Exported -- leads got flagged as exported without ever reaching the sheet, permanently dropped from future sweeps. Now the default (stop on error) so a failed write leaves the lead unmarked and the next sweep retries it.

parameters.query:
-- Mark this session as exported so the next sweep skips it. Kept in
-- current_context (not a new table) so it's wiped automatically whenever
-- the session resets -- meaning a prospect who comes back later and
-- abandons AGAIN is correctly swept again as fresh activity.
UPDATE app_bot_sessions
SET current_context = jsonb_set(current_context, '{leadExported}', 'true'::jsonb, true)
WHERE phone = $1;

nodes.name: Mark Lead Exported
nodes.notes: Runs once per swept lead. Deliberately does NOT touch updated_at -- that column is the conversation-activity clock the Decision Node reads for its 30-minute timeout, and bumping it here would make a dead session look alive.

parameters.query:
-- Outbound hashes are only consulted for 15 minutes after a send; a day
-- of retention is already generous. Pruned here rather than in the main
-- workflow so the customer-facing path never carries housekeeping cost.
DELETE FROM app_bot_outbound WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day';
